# BBC

> > The British Broadcasting Corporation's regional network providing comprehensive news, sport, and cultural programming across the United Kingdom's nations and regions.

BBC serves the UK with dedicated regional services for Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, and their respective language variants (Cymru for Welsh-language content and Alba for Scottish Gaelic). The corporation covers local news, national sports including football and rugby, and cultural programming that reflects the distinct identities of each nation.

## Key Topics

- Regional News
- Scottish Sport
- Welsh Sport
- Football
- Rugby Union
- BBC Scotland
- Wales
- Northern Ireland
- Glasgow
- Celtic
- Rangers
- Local Stories
- Cultural Programming
- Gaelic Broadcasting
- Regional Identity

## Regional Homepages

- [BBC - Scotland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/scotland): BBC Scotland regional homepage covering news, sport, and culture
- [BBC - Wales - Home](https://www.bbc.com/wales): BBC Wales regional homepage with news, sport, and Welsh programming
- [BBC - Northern Ireland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/northernireland): BBC NI regional hub for news, Radio Ulster, Gaelic Games, and local content

## Language Services

- [BBC - Cymru - Home](https://www.bbc.com/cymru): BBC Cymru Welsh-language homepage for news, culture, and programming
- [BBC - Alba - Home](https://www.bbc.com/alba): BBC Alba Scottish Gaelic broadcasting hub for news and cultural content
